# Trinity Pump & Supply

> Downhole rod pump manufacturing, rebuilds, teardowns, and artificial lift equipment specialist based in Odessa, Texas. Providing precision sucker rod pumps, pump tracking, tubing anchor catchers (TACs), gas separators, and 24/7 Permian Basin field delivery with 100% USA-manufactured pump parts.

Trinity Pump & Supply helps oil and gas operators throughout the Permian, Delaware, and Midland Basins maximize run time and reduce lifting costs. With over 100 years of combined pump shop expertise, our Odessa technicians custom-build API-specification rod pumps, conduct rigorous failure teardowns, track run history, and provide around-the-clock wellsite service.

- [Home](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/): Company overview, 100% USA parts promise, and Odessa pump shop capabilities

## Specialized Downhole Pump Services

- [Downhole Rod Pump Repair & Rebuild](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Full teardown, ultrasonic barrel inspection, precision plunger refits, and API tolerance testing
- [Pump Teardown & Root Cause Failure Analysis](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Detailed metallurgical, gas, and sand-cut wear diagnostics with digital inspection reporting
- [Digital Pump Tracking & Inventory Management](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Serialized downhole tracking to monitor run life, well history, and maintenance cycles
- [Tubing Anchor Catcher (TAC) Inspection & Sales](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Premium Tech-Tac TACs and anchors to prevent tubing stretch and rod wear
- [Downhole Gas Separators & Sand Control](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): High-efficiency downhole separation solutions to prevent gas lock and particulate abrasion
- [Rod Rotators & Accessories](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Mechanical rod rotators that evenly distribute sucker rod wear and extend string life
- [24/7 Field Delivery & Wellsite Hot Shot](https://trinitypumpsupply.com/services/): Rapid equipment delivery directly to Permian Basin wellheads, minimizing downtime
